title: Studio Interfaces lists only what an app's navigation names: views and record pages off the menu, and a module package's dashboards and pages, cannot be opened in Studio at all
body:
Filing gate **① a product defect with a reproduction**. Found by the HotCRM full browser pass objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2320 on `@objectstack/*` 18.2.0: track 6 Studio (report comment 6443071470 on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2320, finding D3; screenshots on branch `claude/project-thread-ozavxm` under `qa/` and in the HotCRM project files `qa-2320/6-studio/`). Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat (`huangyiirene`, session `session_01J8VVAnPkgK6CWrJa6t7Fk5`), which re-read each finding against its screenshot. Batch-of: hotcrm#2320 platform findings.

`finding` class **a** · `reach:` public door: the console on `@objectstack/*` 18.2.0, measured in Chromium against the HotCRM seed.

## What is seen

- Studio › HotCRM › **Interfaces** lists the navigation tree only: 1 of its 5 pages, 4 of its 65 views, its 4 dashboards. Every other list view (🔥 Hot Leads, Lead Pipeline, …) and the record pages (Account / Lead / Opportunity Detail, Account Workbench) are nowhere in Studio (`m-iface-nav-bottom.png`).
- Studio › HotCRM Service (or Revenue, Marketing) › **Interfaces**: "This package has no app yet. Create an app to design its navigation and interfaces." with a disabled **Create app** — so the Service package's **Service Overview** dashboard and **Case Detail** page cannot be opened in Studio (`s-studio-service-interfaces.png`, `s-service-create-app-hover.png`).
- Setup › Metadata lists and opens all of them (`o-setup-meta-view-list.png`, `o-setup-meta-page-list.png`).

The Studio landing promises for installed packages: "Code and installed packages are read-only: **browse them here**".

**Who loses:** an admin inspecting a packaged app (or a module package with no app of its own) cannot reach most of its interface metadata from Studio.

## Expected

Interfaces lists a package's views, pages and dashboards, whether or not a navigation entry names them (navigation-named ones first is fine), and a package without an app still lists what it ships.

## Dedupe

`search_issues` objectstack "Studio interfaces lists only navigation items views pages not in menu module package no app yet" and a second wording: 7 hits — #26740, #26743, #26738, #26745, #26746, #26732 (open, Studio Interfaces inspectors and pickers), #23005 (closed). None reports the listing itself.

**Reader who acts:** the Studio Interfaces pillar owner (`domain:ui`, `area:studio`).
